name: hook-worktree-ghostty
description: Worktree Ghostty Layout. Opens a 3-panel Ghostty layout when creating worktrees: Claude Code (left) | lazygit (top-right) / yazi (bottom-right). Creates worktrees in a sibling directory (../worktrees/<repo>/<name>/) and cleans up on removal. macOS only. Requires: jq, Ghostty terminal, lazygit, ya...
